note: The raw fuzzer input is interpreted as an in-memory SFNT font and reaches FreeType face initialization.
The SFNT initializer locates the fvar table supplied by the input font.
The fvar instance count is trusted after the table-length check and is later adjusted if no default instance is found.
When the fvar named instances do not contain the default coordinates, FreeType synthesizes one additional instance.
The adjusted instance count is propagated through style_flags to the TrueType variation loader.
TT_Get_MM_Var uses the adjusted count, which can be larger than the count physically present in the fvar table.

code: face->blend->mmvar_len = sizeof ( FT_MM_Var ) + fvar_head.axisCount * sizeof ( FT_Var_Axis ) + num_instances * sizeof ( FT_Var_Named_Style ) + num_instances * fvar_head.axisCount * sizeof ( FT_Fixed ) + 5 * fvar_head.axisCount;
note: The destination mmvar allocation is sized from the adjusted named-instance count and the axis count.
The synthesized default instance is written at the first index after the on-disk fvar instances; malformed counts exercise this heap write path.
